short: Ahead on data: the first public three-mode lip-video corpus. Standard on transfer: the silent drop was known, and most of it is test-mode difficulty, not the training mode.
position: The paper changes M11 (a public lip-video corpus with normal, whispered and silent speech) and M04 (a train-mode by test-mode grid). The corpus is ahead and was still the visual reference in 2023. The transfer finding is standard: the silent drop was known from ultrasound and visual-whisper work, and on a fixed silent test set training on silent speech gains only 2.5 to 3.2 points, so the authors' "significant performance drop" from vocalised-only training, given without a significance test, outruns the evidence.
